bosses.name: Raging Tiger
bosses.strategy: Hey, we can win this one! Go ahead and use Yuri's Fusion skill to become the Death Emperor, then use normal attacks to wipe out the Raging Tiger. He's not tough at all, and should take just a couple turns to take out.

bosses.name: Hellcat, Hellcat
bosses.strategy: They're not too bad; just have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and wail on them with regular attacks while Alice keeps both of you healed with either Cure or Thera Leaves.

bosses.name: Felinus
bosses.strategy: This lady isn't to be taken lightly. She can use the Wind Fang ability to hit everyone for Wind damage, and after a couple of turns, your whole party will be in need of healing, so beware. Since she's a Wind class, have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use the Flying Stones skill to do some decent damage to her, followed by regular attack. Alice should be keeping everyone healed, as should Zhuzhen. If no one needs healing then, have Zhuzhen use his Ogre Flamedance spell, and Alice should attack normally. As long as you stay healed and don't let Alice go Berserk, you should be fine.

bosses.name: Yamaraja: Earth
bosses.strategy: Note that Yamaraja: Earth is actually a WATER class. As I mentioned above, he's pretty dangerous! If you can't beat him, level up in town for a while before trying again. I recommend at least level 6 for everyone. His Flash Flood will hit an ally for pretty good damage, while his Large Whirlpool will hit your entire party for major damage, as well as possibly halving your Hit Area on your Ring, so be sure to heal after it hits. His physical attacks are also nothing to sneeze at, as they can take away large chunks of HP at a time. Make sure that Alice and Zhuzhen are in the back row, and when in doubt, just heal. Have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use his Flying Stones attack, followed by normal attacks. Have Alice stay on healing duty the entire time, and have Zhuzhen cast Ogre Flamedance continuously. If needed, have Yuri supplement healing since Zhuzhen's fire magic probably hits for more than Yuri does, and make sure to keep Alice from becoming Berserk.

bosses.name: Water Tiger, Kappa, Kappa
bosses.strategy: Have Yuri fuse into the Death Emperor or Raging Tiger and wail away on the Kappas first, since they have the ability to heal. Have Margarete use her Grenade skill until she's out of MP, then have her attack normally. Have Alice attack normally, unless she's needed for healing. If you want to do some extra damage to the Water Tiger once the Kappas are gone, have Margarete use her Aqua Edge on Yuri and have him attack the Fire-based Water Tiger.

bosses.name: Beast Dog
bosses.strategy: Be wary of its Breath of Fire attack; it'll hit the whole part for pretty good damage. Have each person heal themselves after the hit to be safe. Its physical attacks are bad enough, but it will increase its own strength, making them that much worse, so keep an eye on your HP. To start, have Margarete cast the Aqua Edge on Yuri, followed by using her Grenade skill repeatedly. With a water-based attack, have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and start attacking normally, doing some major damage. Have Alice keep everyone's HP up during the battle, having Margarete help out when needed. As usual, make sure Alice's SP doesn't drop to 0.

bosses.name: Yamaraja: Wind
bosses.strategy: Note that Yamaraja: Wind is actually an EARTH class, so make sure not to fuse into the Raging Tiger. Its Shockwave attack will do decent damage to each character, while its Flying Stones attack will do major damage, but to only one character. However, its PHYSICAL attacks are the ones you have to worry about; it can do a three hit attack that will easily kill a party member, even if they're in the back row, so be sure to stay healed. If you have the Tornado Fusion, have Yuri fuse into that; otherwise, have him fuse into the Death Emperor. Use his Wind Shear/Dark Messenger Spells continuously; if he runs out of MP, have either him or someone else replenish it so he can keep dishing out the damage. Have Margarete on healing duty, using Thera Leaves on whoever needs them, as well as using Mana Leaves on Yuri and Zhuzhen to keep their MP up. Have Zhuzhen use his Ogre Flamedance continuously, stopping to heal if someone needs it. Yuri should be doing the most damage if he has the Tornado Fusion, so keep his MP up while keeping everyone else healed.

bosses.name: Li Li
bosses.strategy: This is just a warm-up, so try to avoid using TOO much MP if possible for the next boss battle. She can and will use Dark Messenger, which not only deals major damage, but can instantly kill a party member, so be careful. Her other attacks are Paralysis (which does decent damage, but you should be guarded against the actual Paralysis effect with your Rosewood Bracelets) and a normal attack, which you shouldn't need to worry about. If you have it, have Yuri use Heaven's Fiend and use the Exorcist Arrow attack; it should do MAJOR damage. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Margarete first, so she has Light-based attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light. Margaret should just be attacking normally, using Thera and Mana Leaves whenever the party's HP/MP are getting low. If you really need a second healer, Heaven's Fiend is perfect for the role, as its Sacred Remedy will heal EVERYONE in the party. If you don't have Heaven's Fiend, have Yuri fuse into either Inferno or Raging Tiger (they are your two physically strongest Fusions at this point) and use normal attacks on her. If he has Inferno, use the Fighting Spirit skill first to increase his attack, then start wailing away on her. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Yuri first, so he has Light-based attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light. Margaret should just be attacking normally, using Thera and Mana Leaves whenever the party's HP/MP are getting low. Not much to worry about (other than Dark Messenger) here.

bosses.name: Li Li
bosses.strategy: At least this time she won't use Dark Messenger, but she still uses Paralysis (which, again, does decent damage, but you should be guarded against the actual Paralysis effect with your Rosewood Bracelets.) Watch out for Hate Storm, as it'll do decent damage to your whole party. Start off by healing, if needed. As with the last battle, if you have it, have Yuri use Heaven's Fiend and use the Exorcist Arrow attack; it should do MAJOR damage. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Margarete first, so she has Light-based attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light. Margaret should just be attacking normally, using Thera and Mana Leaves whenever the party's HP/MP are getting low. If you really need a second healer, Heaven's Fiend is perfect for the role, as its Sacred Remedy will heal EVERYONE in the party, especially after Hate Storm. If you don't have Heaven's Fiend, have Yuri fuse into either Inferno or Raging Tiger (they are your two physically strongest Fusions at this point) and use normal attacks on her. If he has Inferno, use the Fighting Spirit skill first to increase his attack, then start wailing away on her. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Yuri first, so he has Light-based attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light REPEATEDLY. Margaret will be the primary healer once again, as Yuri and Alice should be shelling out some pretty wicked damage to Li Li. Use Thera and Mana Leaves whenever the party's HP/MP are getting low, and you should be fine.

bosses.name: Wugui
bosses.strategy: As with the battle as his father, have Yuri fuse into your physically strongest Soul, Raging Tiger, and just rip into Wugui with physical attacks. He doesn't pose much of a threat, but if you let the battle go on too long, make sure to heal.

bosses.name: Xieshi
bosses.strategy: His Flaming Arm of Death spell will hit your party for a decent amount of damage, but also can Silence your party, so having Bell Bracelets equipped definitely helps a ton. You don't want to be stuck with NO healing abilities at all! I strongly recommend fusing Yuri in the Man Dragon Fusion if you have it, as not only is the enemy fire-based, but you'll be able to heal yourself in a pinch, if need be. Have Yuri use the Flash Flood skill repeatedly, and it should do massive damage each round. If you don't have Man Dragon, then fuse into Raging Tiger and cast Flying Stones to do some decent damage. Zhuzhen should be healing pretty much the entire time. If he does have a free round, have him use Ogre Flamedance, since it'll still do some okay damage, even though the boss is fire-based.

bosses.name: Baigu
bosses.strategy: His Shining Arm of Death spell will hit your party for a decent amount of damage, but also can Paralyze your party, so having Rosewood Bracelets equipped definitely helps a ton. You don't want to be stuck with NO healing abilities at all! Not much of a strategy here, since there's only one thing you can do: Attack. Have Alice be the preferred healer, using Thera Seeds and such, since her attack is the weakest. Keep hammering away, and as long as you stay healed, Baigu will eventually fall.

bosses.name: Qinggu
bosses.strategy: Hopefully you equipped the Pocket Watch on Yuri so that his Judgment Ring is unaffected. No strategy at all here, since all you can do is Attack and Defend. Just battle back and forth until you eventually win. If you've become proficient with your Judgment Ring, try equipping the Flash Badge on Yuri so he'll get a few more turns in. If you still can't win, then you'll have to level up some more and try again.

bosses.name: Yamaraja: War
bosses.strategy: As with Wugui, Yamaraja: War will absorb all magic, making Zhuzhen useful only as a healer. He also uses the Game of Death, just like Wugui; if you don't have those Leonardo's Bears equipped to everyone, they'll have a chance to instantly kill you. His Nightmare attack will hit the entire party for a lot of damage, so make sure heal afterward. The only other thing he does is a hellacious physical attack that'll hit for major damage. Once he starts using Nightmare repeatedly, you could be in a bit of trouble. Have Yuri fuse into Inferno and cast Fighting Spirit on himself, followed by physically attacking Yamaraja every turn. Margarete should be attacking normally, but having her jump in to use Thera Seeds if needed, and Zhuzhen should focus completely on recovery. If you're having trouble staying healed, have Yuri fuse into Heaven's Fiend so you have the whole party healing spell.

bosses.name: Man Dragon, Inferno, Tornado, Heaven's Fiend
bosses.strategy: Rather than list each sub-boss separately, I'm covering them all in this one section, since each one requires basically the same strategy. Each of their HP varies depending on Yuri, so if he's weaker, they'll be weaker as well, and vice versa. If you have the Fusion with the class opposite of one already, fuse into that monster and use its highest powered magic spell against them for major damage. If you don't, then just fuse into the Raging Tiger and wail on them with normal attacks for a few rounds. Make sure to keep yourself healed if you fear that you'll be taken down fairly easily.

bosses.name: Cursed Puppet
bosses.strategy: This is basically the same battle as with Yamaraja: War, only easier. As with Yamaraja: War, the Cursed Puppet will absorb all magic, making Zhuzhen useful only as a healer. He also uses the Game of Death, just as usual; if you don't have those Leonardo's Bears equipped to everyone, they'll have a chance to instantly kill you. His Nightmare attack will hit the entire party for a lot of damage, so make sure heal afterward. The only other thing he does is a hellacious physical attack that'll hit for major damage. Once he starts using Nightmare repeatedly, you could be in a bit of trouble. Have Yuri fuse into Inferno and cast Fighting Spirit on himself, followed by physically attacking Yamaraja every turn. If he has the Mind's Eye equipped, it won't take very long. Margarete should be attacking normally, but having her jump in to use Thera Seeds if needed, and Zhuzhen should focus completely on recovery. If you're having trouble staying healed, have Yuri fuse into Heaven's Fiend so you have the whole party healing spell.

bosses.name: Yamaraja: Stone
bosses.strategy: Note that Yamaraja: Stone is actually a FIRE class, so Man Dragon will be your go-to Fusion if you're taking the magic route. Other than the fact that he uses defensive spells (that don't seem to help him at all), all he'll use are physical attacks. They're not TOO strong, but if he focuses on just one person on two different attacks, he'll whittle their HP down quicker than you realize, so stay healed. Have Yuri either fuse into the Man Dragon and blast him continuously with Flash Flood, or just fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on Yuri first (if he's attacking), then have her use Snipe continuously. Zhuzhen will probably be doing the least amount of damage, so have him on healing duty when HP starts to drop. This Yamaraja is fairly easy compared to the last two bosses.

bosses.name: Badger Devil
bosses.strategy: The Badger Devil uses a Fire Ball attack that doesn't hit for much damage at all, and a physical attack that hits for a slightly decent amount. Either way, it's not much to worry about. The Badger Devil is susceptible to Instant Death, so do one of the following two things: 1) Fuse Yuri into the Death Emperor and cast Dark Messenger. Make sure to hit the small red "Perfect!!" area, and voilà! Dead-dead-deadski. 2) Have Margarete use her Snipe ability. Make sure to hit the small red "Perfect!!" area, and BAM!!! History. If you're lucky, one of the first two steps will kill it. Sadly, it doesn't ALWAYS work. If you don't have luck with either of those, no worries; he's still easy. Have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on Yuri first, then have her use Snipe continuously. He'll fall quickly.

bosses.name: Dehuai
bosses.strategy: Another Fire-based boss? Don't mind if I do! Makes Margarete that much more useful! Dehuai's fire attacks, Magnard and Blaze, will hit your whole party for decent damage, and he also has a rather quick (and interestingly bizarre) physical attack that also does decent to major damage. He also has a Fast Ring attack that hits for decent damage, and it can possibly make your Judgment Ring spin faster. Make sure to keep healed and try to keep that Ring status off! Have Yuri either fuse into the Man Dragon and blast him continuously with Flash Flood, or just fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on Yuri first (if he's attacking), then have her use Snipe continuously. Zhuzhen will probably be doing the least amount of damage, so have him on healing duty when HP starts to drop. He's pretty easy as well, but the challenge is upcoming.

bosses.name: Yamaraja: Calamity
bosses.strategy: Yamaraja will most likely start off with the Crimson Flame spell, dealing MAJOR fire damage to your party and possibly Silencing them as well. His Petrification attack should only do medium damage to your party IF you're protected against it; otherwise, you'll turn to stone, and three Petrified party members equals a game over. He'll also use a Shockwave attack, but it only does a small amount of damage to your whole party. His physical attacks are nothing to sneeze at either; a series of three attacks will do MAJOR damage to a party member. As much as I hate to say this, Yuri will need to be the primary healer of this battle, as he's the only one that has a heal-all spell, and without it, it will be hard to keep up with the healing with just two party members. Fuse him into the Heaven's Fiend, then cast Sacred Remedy if your party needs healing, and if they don't, then use Exorcist Arrow. Zhuzhen should be constantly casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should be using Snipe. When the party's MP starts getting low, have Margarete use Mana Seeds to boost them back up. Due to the sheer amount of HP Yamaraja has, and the fact that your main damage dealer is on healing duty, prepare for a very long battle. You'll most likely need to use at least two Pure Seeds to keep Zhuzhen's and Margarete's SP up.

bosses.name: Tindalos
bosses.strategy: Watch out for his Deathtouch attack; it takes away 75% of your HP, which most of the time is a MAJOR inconvenience. He can also use Fire breath, which will hit for a decent amount of damage. Make sure to keep an eye on his physical attacks as well, as they'll quickly whittle down your HP, hitting for over 100 to a 150 HP per string of attacks. Have Alice be the primary healer, using Cure every round. If it's not needed, have her use Blessed Light instead. Zhuzhen should be using Life Sucker every round (or if you were able to level him up to 23, use Corpse Arm instead), stopping only to help Alice heal when needed. Keith should be using Drain Touch if he needs HP, or Bat Dance if he doesn't. If you were able to get used to Keith's Ring enough to where you're comfortable with him having the Mind's Eye equipped, I recommend that over his Rituals, but still have him use Drain Touch when he needs healed. You'll most likely need to replenish MP and SP throughout the battle, as it will take a while, but be patient and stay healed.

bosses.name: Yuri
bosses.strategy: Yikes! His normal three-hit combo will do MAJOR damage to anyone it hits, so heal the survivor immediately. Yuri has quite a bit of HP, and hits harder than anyone else thus far, so healing will be your immediate priority. After just about 400 HP worth of damage, Yuri will fuse into the Death Emperor, starting to use Dark Messenger. As long as you have Leonardo's Bears equipped, you won't die instantly, but you'll still be hit pretty hard. Again, to reiterate: healing will be your immediate priority. Have two people healing, if needed. For the first round, have Alice cast Holy Edge on Keith to add a Light class to his attack, then devote Alice to healing. There most likely won't be a round where she can attack, but if you can, then use Blessed Light. Zhuzhen should be using Corpse Arm every round, and Keith should be attacking normally every round, with his weapon laced with Holy Edge. Whoever is doing the least amount of damage needs to be helping Alice heal if it's needed. Like the last few battles, it'll probably take long enough that you'll need to replenish your MP and SP as well. Again, have whoever is doing the least amount of damage take care of this.

bosses.name: Fox Face
bosses.strategy: He won't fuse into the Death Emperor this time, but he'll still use his !!! attack. When he does, IMMEDIATELY use a Thera Seed, and DON'T even try to hit the 'Perfect!!' mark; just get Yuri away from 1 HP, and you'll be fine. Fuse into either the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit) and just start wailing away on him with physical attacks. Just keep trading blows, using Thera Seeds to heal whenever your HP starts to get low, and ESPECIALLY after the !!! attack.

bosses.name: Olga
bosses.strategy: Olga will use normal attacks, Blaze, Rock Storm, Nova, Icy Breath, and Lightning to do decent damage each round, maybe 50-60 HP of damage every round. Watch out if she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll want to recover it immediately if she takes too much. Cast Blessed Light rounds one and two, then Cure the next if needed. Blessed Light two rounds, Cure the third. Lather, rinse, repeat. Oh, and don't forget to recover your SP if needed. Not much else you can do since it's just Alice.

bosses.name: Olga
bosses.strategy: Olga's Black Fog attack will do MAJOR damage to your party, as well as Poison each one of them, so it's a good idea to come in with Shell or Cosmic Bracelets equipped. Her Nova attack will do decent damage to a single ally, her Icy Breath attack will hit your whole party for decent damage, and her physical attack just does pathetic damage to a single ally. Watch out if she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll want to recover it immediately if she takes too much. Yuri and Alice are obvious choices for this battle, and you could pretty much pick whomever your favorite is, as they'll all do roughly the same amount of damage. I recommend Margarete just because I had her at a higher level than Keith and Zhuzhen, therefore having more STR and HP. That, and I find Margarete's Ring easier to hit than Keith's. Zhuzhen just sucks up a lot of MP and takes extra turns to replenish it. Okay, okay, I really like her too, if that matters any. Fuse Yuri into Baldo (if you didn't get his level 2 Light Fusion, then fuse into the Heaven's Fiend, as you'll need the healing) and start physically attacking; with the Mind's Eye equipped, he'll be doing major damage. If you didn't put the Mind's Eye on him, then go with the Nova spell instead. Have Alice cast Holy Edge on Yuri her first round so he can keep piling the damage up, then have her cast it on Margarete her second turn so she can start adding in to the damage. Margarete should also be attacking normally. If for some reason Alice doesn't need to heal, have her cast Blessed Light on Olga. If a single ally just needs healed, have Alice do it. If two people need it, have Alice and Margarete do it. If all three need it, then have Yuri do it, as Olga doesn't mess around, and can easily kill your entire party in three turns. I hate taking turns away from Yuri because he just does so much damage, but when everyone needs healed, he's the only one that can do anything about it efficiently.

bosses.name: Night Stalker
bosses.strategy: There's not much to worry about with this guy; other than boosting himself up, his physical attacks do a decent amount of damage, but that's it. Have Alice whoever is attacked. Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit, using Ignition to boost his attack power, then start wailing on the Night Stalker with physical attacks. Have Halley constantly use his Strong Earth attack, which should do pretty decent damage to the wind-based enemy. Have Alice keep everyone healed, using Blessed Light when she's not healing.

bosses.name: Jack
bosses.strategy: Jack will mainly just use his Paralysis attack against you, though you should be guarded by a Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix. He will also use pretty strong physical attacks, and his Slash attack, which will do MAJOR damage to one party member, so make sure to stay healed. He will use Thera Seeds when his HP starts to drop. When fighting, keep in mind that you have a harder boss battle right after this, with no chance to heal. Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then have him attack as normal. Have Halley cast Strong Earth continuously (not Aqua Blade, since Jack is water based) for the whole battle, unless he's learned Air Shot by now, then by all means, use that. Alice should be healing as needed, using Blessed Light when no healing is needed. If you're comfortable at the end, take a turn or two to make sure everyone is healed to the max and ready for the next battle.

bosses.name: Mammon
bosses.strategy: Mammon's normal attacks will hit for pretty decent damage, but its biggest threat is its Petrification attack, which hopefully you've prevented with either a Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix, though it'll still do a decent amount of damage, even if you did. It will also use a Shockwave spell, doing quite a bit a damage to your entire party, as well as Needlerain, a strong attack to just one party member. Its Howling skill will replenish its HP by 500+ once it's near dying, but lucky for you, Yuri's a powerhouse and will take that away and then some in one round. As usual, have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then have him attack as normal. Have Halley use his Air Edge on Yuri to increase Yuri's damage output, then have him cast Aqua Blade for the remainder of the battle, unless he's learned Air Shot by now, then by all means, use that. Alice should be healing as needed, using Blessed Light when no healing is needed.

bosses.name: Rausan
bosses.strategy: Rausan will usually start out the battle with Elder Sign, causing your special attacks to be weakened quite a bit. This should only really affect Halley, but not enough to keep him from using his skills. He'll attempt to Silence you as well, but as long as you have Cosmic Bracelets, it'll just inflict a lot of damage. He'll also use Blaze, which will do a decent amount of damage to your whole party. As usual, have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then have him attack as normal. Have Halley use Aqua Blade every round (since Rausan is Fire-based), stopping only to help Alice heal. Alice should be healing as needed, using Blessed Light when no healing is needed.

bosses.name: Olga
bosses.strategy: As before, Olga's Black Fog attack will do MAJOR damage to your party, as well as Poison each one of them, so it's a good idea to come in with Cosmic Bracelets equipped. Her normal attacks don't do too much damage, but her Icy Breath, Rock Storm and Lightning attacks will also both do quite a bit of damage to your entire party, so be careful. Watch out if she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll want to recover it immediately if she takes too much. Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then have him attack as normal. With his attacked laced with Alice's Holy Edge, he'll be doing MAJOR damage. Of course, have Alice use Holy Edge to start with on Yuri, then have her on healing duty. Have Halley use Air Shot every round, helping Alice heal as needed. If you have it, have Alice take advantage of her Arc spell and just heal every round, it makes this battle MUCH easier. If you're unable to keep up with healing while trying to dish out the damage, AND if Alice doesn't have Arc, then have Yuri fuse into Baldo instead of Ifrit, using his healing spell to take care of the party while Alice and Halley use Blessed Light and Air Shot to make up the difference.

bosses.name: Albert, Amon
bosses.strategy: Albert's Holy Chest attack will do some decent damage, but even worse, it'll reduce the amount of SP your entire party has by half, so making sure that you had those Will Power Accessories equipped will help MAJORLY in keeping the SP damage from happening. Other than that, he has a physical attack that will do a decent amount of damage, and his Revelation attack will also do a decent amount of damage, but to your entire party with a chance of Instant Death. He rarely uses Revelation, but if you have problems with the Instant Death it causes, equip some Leonardo's Bears and try again. Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit (or Forron if he has it) and cast Ignition (or Battle Cry) to boost his attack (as well as Margarete's, if you're using Ifrit and have the time), then have him attack normally every round. Alice should cast Holy Edge on both Yuri and Margarete to start with, then have her be devoted each round to casting Arc to keep everyone healed. Margarete should have the Mind's Eye equipped and attacking normally while being laced with Holy Edge, just like Yuri. Any time after dealing over 2000 damage to Albert, he will fuse into Amon. Continue with the exact same strategy as above, minus the Holy Edge since Amon is non-class. Amon's Atomic Dust spell will do pretty good damage to your entire party, and he'll also hit with his physical attacks, which can cause major damage to a single ally. You need to watch out for Demon Rays though, as it'll either kill or nearly kill whomever it hits.

bosses.name: Golden Bat
bosses.strategy: He says you have 5 turns to defeat him before he obliterates Keith, but you technically have 6. It's not hard to succeed, but if you miss some hits, you could be in trouble. Keith can only attack normally, so just keep doing that. It should only take three turns max, unless you didn't equip the Mind's Eye, then it'll probably take all six. If you're having a hard time with this battle, then level Keith up to where he can definitely deal 1500 damage within four or five turns, to be safe. NOTE     Even though you already have it equipped for this battle, the ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   reward for winning is the DemonSwd-Tyrving......

bosses.name: Orb Chaos
bosses.strategy: She has several different spells that will increase her stats by 25-30%, so once she's done doing that, be very careful, as they went from very strong to deadly. She WILL almost kill Yuri in one set of attacks once her attack is boosted, she's THAT strong! Alice won't have time to do anything except Arc once Orb Chaos starts attacking. Other than the boosting spells, Orb Chaos attacks normally for major damage, and uses a spell called Expression that can not only do pretty good damage, but can also Paralyze your entire party! If you don't have those Crucifixes equipped, good luck winning, especially when she starts using Expression each turn, one after another. Even though he may barely have enough SP to do it, have Yuri fuse into Amon, then have one of the girls use a Pure Seed/Root on him to give him some breathing room, then have him attack normally. Alice should be casting Arc every round, and Margarete should be attacking normally every round, since both she and Yuri should have Mind's Eyes equipped. NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Alice's best weapon, ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Holy Book-Flesh.

bosses.name: Cherubim
bosses.strategy: Ah, Brain Hopper; I miss this music. In any case, Cherubim will usually start the battle with the !!! attack, reducing a party member's HP to 1, or Divine Punishment, doing pretty good damage to your entire party, as well as causing various status effects, so make sure to heal them straight away. He will continue using them throughout the battle, and his physical attacks will hit an ally for pretty decent damage as well. Note that he won't take hardly any damage from your special attacks, so focus only on physical attacks. Have Yuri fuse into Amon and attack normally while Alice casts Arc as needed, leaving Margarete to also attack normally, supporting Alice when needed to replenish Yuri's SP, as well as Alice's MP. Cherubim isn't really that complicated, so as long as you have Crucifixes equipped to everyone and have Alice use Arc every round, then it's just a matter of taking the time to whittle away his HP. Just make sure not to let anyone go Berserk. NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Zhuzhen's best weapon, ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Holy Peak Staff.

bosses.name: Seraphim
bosses.strategy: Seraphim hits pretty hard, enough to kill right off the bat, so once again, Alice will be doing nothing but Arc this battle. Other than his normal attacks, he will use Divine Punishment, doing pretty good damage to your entire party, as well as causing various status effects, so make sure to heal them straight away. Have Yuri fuse into Amon and keep at him with physical attacks, and have Margarete attack normally as well, taking breaks to help replenish MP and SP as needed. Since Seraphim has lower HP than Cherubim, you probably won't have to replenish either MP nor SP. Like Cherubim, Seraphim isn't really that complicated, so as long as you have Crucifixes equipped to everyone and have Alice use Arc every round, then it's just a matter of taking the time to whittle away his HP. It actually won't take nearly as long, since Seraphim only has 40% the HP that Cherubim had. NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Halley's best weapon, ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Volt Snipe.

bosses.name: Mad Bull, Dragner, Ifrit, Icarus, Baldo, Charon, Lobo, Egil, Forron, Seravi, Sandalphon, Czernobog
bosses.strategy: Rather than list each sub-boss separately, I'm covering them all in this one section, since each one requires basically the same strategy. Each of their HP varies depending on Yuri, so if he's weaker, they'll be weaker as well, and vice versa. If you want to use the Mind's Eye, just fuse into Amon and wail on them for a few rounds, making sure to heal if necessary. If you don't want to use the Mind's Eye, fuse into the highest level monster that is the opposite class of the one you're fighting. Make sure to keep yourself healed if you fear that you'll be taken down fairly easily.

bosses.name: Grail Mask, Gold Mask, Staff Mask, Sword Mask, Grail Mask, Gold Mask, Staff Mask, Sword Mask
bosses.strategy: 1st Encounter = Stronger form, must be fought in order for easy battles. 2nd Encounter = Weaker form, defeated once and have lost their powers. 1) Grail Mask - He's a joke. Your hit area will be DOUBLED, and he's easily damaged by physical attacks. He should only take two turns, max. 2) Gold Mask - A little harder than the Grail Mask, but not by much. He can't be harmed by physical attacks, so you must take him out with nothing but special attacks. It'll take longer than the Grail Mask, but he's not a threat at all. 3) Staff Mask - A little easier than the Gold Mask, but not by much. He's just the opposite of the Gold Mask; he can't be harmed by special attacks, so you must take him out with nothing but physical attacks, so it shouldn't be a problem. Again, not very much of a threat at this point. 4) Sword Mask - The last of the Masks is actually almost as easy as the first! He doesn't have any strong points like the last two, nor do you have a wider hit area, but either way, it should only take two, possibly three rounds to take this one out. 5) Round Two! - Once you have defeated all Four Masks, keep your Malice in the red and wait for them to come around to fight once more! This time around, they don't need to be fought in any order, and they only take one hit to die. Make sure to do this so you get all eight of their entries for the Monster Library.

bosses.name: Atman
bosses.strategy: Atman can still kill Alice in two rounds, so make sure that she stays healed. As for attacks, this time around, Atman will still use Eradication, but it won't kill; instead, it'll just do a pretty good amount of damage, as well as reduce SP. He can also attack normally, as well as use Dragon Cry and other strong class spells for decent damage. Have Yuri fuse into Amon and rip into Atman with physical attacks, while Alice should be using Arc every round to keep their HP maxed. If for some reason she gets a free turn, have her cast Advent to help Yuri deal some damage.

bosses.name: Ben Hyuga, SeraphicRadiance
bosses.strategy: '———————————————————'   preferably, a Thera Extract. Fuse into Amon, or if you need some spare SP, then Lobo (since he has the 2nd highest P-Def at this point, as well as the same P-Atk as Amon). All you'll be doing is physically attacking a round or two, then healing the next. Yep, that's it... pretty boring actually, but any other route will likely get you killed. Trust me, it's worth it. If you find yourself in trouble, try using Third Keys to help dish out damage when you have an opportunity to. If you're STILL having trouble with him, then you'll just have to level up and try again.

bosses.name: Soul Block
bosses.strategy: Yes, I know, Yuri's level is insanely high, but blame the game for not letting you be able to take him out of your party so you can level others up. It shouldn't affect much, as he's just as much of a powerhouse ten levels earlier. In any case, the Soul Block CANNOT be harmed physically, so it'll be up to your special attacks to take him out. He has some really strong physical attacks, as well as the light spell, Pulse, and the Shockwave spell, neither of which are quite as strong, but hit everyone. Fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting For Everyone to boost your party, then have him continually cast For Tomorrow. (Just know that For Everyone ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster ring, so if you can't keep up with it, don't worry about casting it to begin with.) Have Alice use Advent and have Margarete use Diving Bomber; whoever is dealing the least amount of damage (likely Alice), have her replenish Yuri's MP with Mana Roots every other round. Yuri's For Tomorrow SHOULD keep your party healed, but in case it falls behind, have Alice ready with an Arc to bring you back up to snuff. If you're having trouble with the hit areas of the SeraphicRadiance, then you may want to start using Bronze Daggers (or Arrowheads for just Yuri) on your party to widen the hit areas. If you're STILL having trouble, then you'll probably be better of using Amon and his Demon Rays spell.

bosses.name: Hate
bosses.strategy: Hate will use Hate Storm and Black Fog, but luckily we have Crucifixes now, so as long as they're equipped, we'll just receive minor to decent damage to the whole party instead of ring anomalies and poison. It'll also attempt to paralyze you, but will do a decent amount of damage to a single ally instead. Fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting For Everyone to boost your party, then have him continually attack from there on, using Third Keys if you have spares, with Alice's Holy Edge on him. (Remember, For Everyone ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster ring, so if you can't keep up with it, don't worry about casting it to begin with.) Have Alice start off by casting Holy Edge on both Yuri and Margarete, then use Advent when healing isn't needed, and have her use Arc when it is. Margarete should be attacking physically as well with Third Keys. This boss is actually a lot easier than the last.

bosses.name: Scapegoat
bosses.strategy: The Scapegoat will use Wind Fang that will hit your whole party for a small amount of damage, and will also attack normally on a single ally for decent damage. He can also use Deathtouch, which if you remember, instantly puts an ally into critical HP status, so make sure to heal straight away when he uses it. As usual, fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting For Everyone to boost your party, then have him continually attack from there on, using Third Keys if you have spares. (Remember, For Everyone ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster ring, so if you can't keep up with it, don't worry about casting it to begin with.) Have Alice use Advent when healing isn't needed, and have her use Arc when it is. Margarete should be attacking physically as well with Third Keys. Just make sure to stay healed and you should be fine.

bosses.name: Messiah, Meta-God
bosses.strategy: He will start the battle off with Holy Chest, which would normally dampen your SP, but with the Will Powers equipped, it'll only do a decent amount of damage. He will also use the !!! attack, so make sure that you heal IMMEDIATELY after it hits so you don't lose your ally. Other than that, he just uses Status Abnormality, which won't do hardly any damage, and as long as you have a Crucifix on, you don't need to worry about the anomalies. He can also heal himself with Grace, and even though it only SAYS 999 HP is healed, trust me, a lot more than that is healed. There is no cap on the damage or amount healed; just the numbers displayed. As usual, fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting For Everyone to boost your party, then have him continually attack from there on, using Third Keys. There is one more battle after this, so save your Fifth and Seventh Keys for that. (Remember, For Everyone ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster ring, so if you can't keep up with it, don't worry about casting it to begin with.) Alice will most likely be casting Arc every round, but whenever she happens to get a free turn, have her cast Advent. Margarete should be attacking physically as well with Third Keys.

blocks.text: Listed here are all of the sub-bosses and bosses in the game, as well as the strategies to defeat them. This section is listed in the order that they were encountered within the walkthrough.

boss.name: Raging Tiger
boss.strategy:
Hey, we can win this one! Go ahead and use Yuri's Fusion skill to become
the Death Emperor, then use normal attacks to wipe out the Raging Tiger.
He's not tough at all, and should take just a couple turns to take out.

boss.name: Hellcat, Hellcat
boss.strategy:
They're not too bad; just have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and wail
on them with regular attacks while Alice keeps both of you healed with
either Cure or Thera Leaves.

boss.name: Felinus
boss.strategy:
This lady isn't to be taken lightly. She can use the Wind Fang ability to
hit everyone for Wind damage, and after a couple of turns, your whole
party will be in need of healing, so beware.

Since she's a Wind class, have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use
the Flying Stones skill to do some decent damage to her, followed by
regular attack. Alice should be keeping everyone healed, as should
Zhuzhen. If no one needs healing then, have Zhuzhen use his Ogre
Flamedance spell, and Alice should attack normally. As long as you stay
healed and don't let Alice go Berserk, you should be fine.

boss.name: Yamaraja: Earth
boss.strategy:
Note that Yamaraja: Earth is actually a WATER class. As I mentioned
above, he's pretty dangerous! If you can't beat him, level up in town for
a while before trying again. I recommend at least level 6 for everyone.

His Flash Flood will hit an ally for pretty good damage, while his Large
Whirlpool will hit your entire party for major damage, as well as
possibly halving your Hit Area on your Ring, so be sure to heal after it
hits. His physical attacks are also nothing to sneeze at, as they can
take away large chunks of HP at a time. Make sure that Alice and Zhuzhen
are in the back row, and when in doubt, just heal.

Have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use his Flying Stones attack,
followed by normal attacks. Have Alice stay on healing duty the entire
time, and have Zhuzhen cast Ogre Flamedance continuously. If needed, have
Yuri supplement healing since Zhuzhen's fire magic probably hits for more
than Yuri does, and make sure to keep Alice from becoming Berserk.

boss.name: Water Tiger, Kappa, Kappa
boss.strategy:
Have Yuri fuse into the Death Emperor or Raging Tiger and wail away on
the Kappas first, since they have the ability to heal. Have Margarete use
her Grenade skill until she's out of MP, then have her attack normally.
Have Alice attack normally, unless she's needed for healing. If you want
to do some extra damage to the Water Tiger once the Kappas are gone, have
Margarete use her Aqua Edge on Yuri and have him attack the Fire-based
Water Tiger.

boss.name: Beast Dog
boss.strategy:
Be wary of its Breath of Fire attack; it'll hit the whole part for pretty
good damage. Have each person heal themselves after the hit to be safe.
Its physical attacks are bad enough, but it will increase its own
strength, making them that much worse, so keep an eye on your HP.

To start, have Margarete cast the Aqua Edge on Yuri, followed by using
her Grenade skill repeatedly. With a water-based attack, have Yuri fuse
into the Raging Tiger and start attacking normally, doing some major
damage. Have Alice keep everyone's HP up during the battle, having
Margarete help out when needed. As usual, make sure Alice's SP doesn't
drop to 0.

boss.name: Yamaraja: Wind
boss.strategy:
Note that Yamaraja: Wind is actually an EARTH class, so make sure not to
fuse into the Raging Tiger.

Its Shockwave attack will do decent damage to each character, while its
Flying Stones attack will do major damage, but to only one character.
However, its PHYSICAL attacks are the ones you have to worry about; it
can do a three hit attack that will easily kill a party member, even if
they're in the back row, so be sure to stay healed.

If you have the Tornado Fusion, have Yuri fuse into that; otherwise, have
him fuse into the Death Emperor. Use his Wind Shear/Dark Messenger Spells
continuously; if he runs out of MP, have either him or someone else
replenish it so he can keep dishing out the damage. Have Margarete on
healing duty, using Thera Leaves on whoever needs them, as well as using
Mana Leaves on Yuri and Zhuzhen to keep their MP up. Have Zhuzhen use his
Ogre Flamedance continuously, stopping to heal if someone needs it.

Yuri should be doing the most damage if he has the Tornado Fusion, so
keep his MP up while keeping everyone else healed.

boss.name: Li Li
boss.strategy:
This is just a warm-up, so try to avoid using TOO much MP if possible for
the next boss battle.

She can and will use Dark Messenger, which not only deals major damage,
but can instantly kill a party member, so be careful. Her other attacks
are Paralysis (which does decent damage, but you should be guarded
against the actual Paralysis effect with your Rosewood Bracelets) and a
normal attack, which you shouldn't need to worry about.

If you have it, have Yuri use Heaven's Fiend and use the Exorcist Arrow
attack; it should do MAJOR damage. Alice should cast Holy Edge on
Margarete first, so she has Light-based attacks, then she should cast
Blessed Light. Margaret should just be attacking normally, using Thera
and Mana Leaves whenever the party's HP/MP are getting low. If you really
need a second healer, Heaven's Fiend is perfect for the role, as its
Sacred Remedy will heal EVERYONE in the party.

If you don't have Heaven's Fiend, have Yuri fuse into either Inferno or
Raging Tiger (they are your two physically strongest Fusions at this
point) and use normal attacks on her. If he has Inferno, use the Fighting
Spirit skill first to increase his attack, then start wailing away on
her. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Yuri first, so he has Light-based
attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light. Margaret should just be
attacking normally, using Thera and Mana Leaves whenever the party's
HP/MP are getting low. Not much to worry about (other than Dark
Messenger) here.

boss.name: Li Li
boss.strategy:
At least this time she won't use Dark Messenger, but she still uses
Paralysis (which, again, does decent damage, but you should be guarded
against the actual Paralysis effect with your Rosewood Bracelets.) Watch
out for Hate Storm, as it'll do decent damage to your whole party.

Start off by healing, if needed. As with the last battle, if you have it,
have Yuri use Heaven's Fiend and use the Exorcist Arrow attack; it should
do MAJOR damage. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Margarete first, so she
has Light-based attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light. Margaret
should just be attacking normally, using Thera and Mana Leaves whenever
the party's HP/MP are getting low. If you really need a second healer,
Heaven's Fiend is perfect for the role, as its Sacred Remedy will heal
EVERYONE in the party, especially after Hate Storm.

If you don't have Heaven's Fiend, have Yuri fuse into either Inferno or
Raging Tiger (they are your two physically strongest Fusions at this
point) and use normal attacks on her. If he has Inferno, use the Fighting
Spirit skill first to increase his attack, then start wailing away on
her. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Yuri first, so he has Light-based
attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light REPEATEDLY. Margaret will be
the primary healer once again, as Yuri and Alice should be shelling out
some pretty wicked damage to Li Li. Use Thera and Mana Leaves whenever
the party's HP/MP are getting low, and you should be fine.

boss.name: Wugui
boss.strategy:
As with the battle as his father, have Yuri fuse into your physically
strongest Soul, Raging Tiger, and just rip into Wugui with physical
attacks. He doesn't pose much of a threat, but if you let the battle go
on too long, make sure to heal.

boss.name: Xieshi
boss.strategy:
His Flaming Arm of Death spell will hit your party for a decent amount of
damage, but also can Silence your party, so having Bell Bracelets
equipped definitely helps a ton. You don't want to be stuck with NO
healing abilities at all!

I strongly recommend fusing Yuri in the Man Dragon Fusion if you have it,
as not only is the enemy fire-based, but you'll be able to heal yourself
in a pinch, if need be. Have Yuri use the Flash Flood skill repeatedly,
and it should do massive damage each round. If you don't have Man Dragon,
then fuse into Raging Tiger and cast Flying Stones to do some decent
damage.

Zhuzhen should be healing pretty much the entire time. If he does have a
free round, have him use Ogre Flamedance, since it'll still do some okay
damage, even though the boss is fire-based.

boss.name: Baigu
boss.strategy:
His Shining Arm of Death spell will hit your party for a decent amount of
damage, but also can Paralyze your party, so having Rosewood Bracelets
equipped definitely helps a ton. You don't want to be stuck with NO
healing abilities at all!

Not much of a strategy here, since there's only one thing you can do:
Attack. Have Alice be the preferred healer, using Thera Seeds and such,
since her attack is the weakest. Keep hammering away, and as long as you
stay healed, Baigu will eventually fall.

boss.name: Qinggu
boss.strategy:
Hopefully you equipped the Pocket Watch on Yuri so that his Judgment Ring
is unaffected.

No strategy at all here, since all you can do is Attack and Defend. Just
battle back and forth until you eventually win. If you've become
proficient with your Judgment Ring, try equipping the Flash Badge on Yuri
so he'll get a few more turns in. If you still can't win, then you'll
have to level up some more and try again.

boss.name: Yamaraja: War
boss.strategy:
As with Wugui, Yamaraja: War will absorb all magic, making Zhuzhen useful
only as a healer. He also uses the Game of Death, just like Wugui; if you
don't have those Leonardo's Bears equipped to everyone, they'll have a
chance to instantly kill you. His Nightmare attack will hit the entire
party for a lot of damage, so make sure heal afterward. The only other
thing he does is a hellacious physical attack that'll hit for major
damage. Once he starts using Nightmare repeatedly, you could be in a bit
of trouble.

Have Yuri fuse into Inferno and cast Fighting Spirit on himself, followed
by physically attacking Yamaraja every turn. Margarete should be
attacking normally, but having her jump in to use Thera Seeds if needed,
and Zhuzhen should focus completely on recovery.

If you're having trouble staying healed, have Yuri fuse into Heaven's
Fiend so you have the whole party healing spell.

boss.name: Man Dragon, Inferno, Tornado, Heaven's Fiend
boss.strategy:
Rather than list each sub-boss separately, I'm covering them all in this
one section, since each one requires basically the same strategy.

Each of their HP varies depending on Yuri, so if he's weaker, they'll be
weaker as well, and vice versa.

If you have the Fusion with the class opposite of one already, fuse into
that monster and use its highest powered magic spell against them for
major damage. If you don't, then just fuse into the Raging Tiger and wail
on them with normal attacks for a few rounds. Make sure to keep yourself
healed if you fear that you'll be taken down fairly easily.

boss.name: Cursed Puppet
boss.strategy:
This is basically the same battle as with Yamaraja: War, only easier. As
with Yamaraja: War, the Cursed Puppet will absorb all magic, making
Zhuzhen useful only as a healer. He also uses the Game of Death, just as
usual; if you don't have those Leonardo's Bears equipped to everyone,
they'll have a chance to instantly kill you. His Nightmare attack will
hit the entire party for a lot of damage, so make sure heal afterward.
The only other thing he does is a hellacious physical attack that'll hit
for major damage. Once he starts using Nightmare repeatedly, you could be
in a bit of trouble.

Have Yuri fuse into Inferno and cast Fighting Spirit on himself, followed
by physically attacking Yamaraja every turn. If he has the Mind's Eye
equipped, it won't take very long. Margarete should be attacking
normally, but having her jump in to use Thera Seeds if needed, and
Zhuzhen should focus completely on recovery.

If you're having trouble staying healed, have Yuri fuse into Heaven's
Fiend so you have the whole party healing spell.

boss.name: Yamaraja: Stone
boss.strategy:
Note that Yamaraja: Stone is actually a FIRE class, so Man Dragon will be
your go-to Fusion if you're taking the magic route.

Other than the fact that he uses defensive spells (that don't seem to
help him at all), all he'll use are physical attacks. They're not TOO
strong, but if he focuses on just one person on two different attacks,
he'll whittle their HP down quicker than you realize, so stay healed.

Have Yuri either fuse into the Man Dragon and blast him continuously with
Flash Flood, or just fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting
Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be
continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on
Yuri first (if he's attacking), then have her use Snipe continuously.
Zhuzhen will probably be doing the least amount of damage, so have him on
healing duty when HP starts to drop. This Yamaraja is fairly easy
compared to the last two bosses.

boss.name: Badger Devil
boss.strategy:
The Badger Devil uses a Fire Ball attack that doesn't hit for much damage
at all, and a physical attack that hits for a slightly decent amount.
Either way, it's not much to worry about.

The Badger Devil is susceptible to Instant Death, so do one of the
following two things:

1) Fuse Yuri into the Death Emperor and cast Dark Messenger. Make sure to
hit the small red "Perfect!!" area, and voilà! Dead-dead-deadski.

2) Have Margarete use her Snipe ability. Make sure to hit the small red
"Perfect!!" area, and BAM!!! History.

If you're lucky, one of the first two steps will kill it. Sadly, it
doesn't ALWAYS work.

If you don't have luck with either of those, no worries; he's still easy.
Have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit)
and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be
continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on
Yuri first, then have her use Snipe continuously. He'll fall quickly.

boss.name: Dehuai
boss.strategy:
Another Fire-based boss? Don't mind if I do! Makes Margarete that much
more useful!

Dehuai's fire attacks, Magnard and Blaze, will hit your whole party for
decent damage, and he also has a rather quick (and interestingly bizarre)
physical attack that also does decent to major damage. He also has a Fast
Ring attack that hits for decent damage, and it can possibly make your
Judgment Ring spin faster. Make sure to keep healed and try to keep that
Ring status off!

Have Yuri either fuse into the Man Dragon and blast him continuously with
Flash Flood, or just fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting
Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be
continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on
Yuri first (if he's attacking), then have her use Snipe continuously.
Zhuzhen will probably be doing the least amount of damage, so have him on
healing duty when HP starts to drop. He's pretty easy as well, but the
challenge is upcoming.

boss.name: Yamaraja: Calamity
boss.strategy:
Yamaraja will most likely start off with the Crimson Flame spell, dealing
MAJOR fire damage to your party and possibly Silencing them as well. His
Petrification attack should only do medium damage to your party IF you're
protected against it; otherwise, you'll turn to stone, and three
Petrified party members equals a game over. He'll also use a Shockwave
attack, but it only does a small amount of damage to your whole party.
His physical attacks are nothing to sneeze at either; a series of three
attacks will do MAJOR damage to a party member.

As much as I hate to say this, Yuri will need to be the primary healer of
this battle, as he's the only one that has a heal-all spell, and without
it, it will be hard to keep up with the healing with just two party
members. Fuse him into the Heaven's Fiend, then cast Sacred Remedy if
your party needs healing, and if they don't, then use Exorcist Arrow.
Zhuzhen should be constantly casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should be
using Snipe. When the party's MP starts getting low, have Margarete use
Mana Seeds to boost them back up.

Due to the sheer amount of HP Yamaraja has, and the fact that your main
damage dealer is on healing duty, prepare for a very long battle. You'll
most likely need to use at least two Pure Seeds to keep Zhuzhen's and
Margarete's SP up.

boss.name: Tindalos
boss.strategy:
Watch out for his Deathtouch attack; it takes away 75% of your HP, which
most of the time is a MAJOR inconvenience. He can also use Fire breath,
which will hit for a decent amount of damage. Make sure to keep an eye on
his physical attacks as well, as they'll quickly whittle down your HP,
hitting for over 100 to a 150 HP per string of attacks.

Have Alice be the primary healer, using Cure every round. If it's not
needed, have her use Blessed Light instead. Zhuzhen should be using Life
Sucker every round (or if you were able to level him up to 23, use Corpse
Arm instead), stopping only to help Alice heal when needed. Keith should
be using Drain Touch if he needs HP, or Bat Dance if he doesn't.

If you were able to get used to Keith's Ring enough to where you're
comfortable with him having the Mind's Eye equipped, I recommend that
over his Rituals, but still have him use Drain Touch when he needs
healed.

You'll most likely need to replenish MP and SP throughout the battle, as
it will take a while, but be patient and stay healed.

boss.name: Yuri
boss.strategy:
Yikes! His normal three-hit combo will do MAJOR damage to anyone it hits,
so heal the survivor immediately. Yuri has quite a bit of HP, and hits
harder than anyone else thus far, so healing will be your immediate
priority.

After just about 400 HP worth of damage, Yuri will fuse into the Death
Emperor, starting to use Dark Messenger. As long as you have Leonardo's
Bears equipped, you won't die instantly, but you'll still be hit pretty
hard. Again, to reiterate: healing will be your immediate priority. Have
two people healing, if needed.

For the first round, have Alice cast Holy Edge on Keith to add a Light
class to his attack, then devote Alice to healing. There most likely
won't be a round where she can attack, but if you can, then use Blessed
Light. Zhuzhen should be using Corpse Arm every round, and Keith should
be attacking normally every round, with his weapon laced with Holy Edge.
Whoever is doing the least amount of damage needs to be helping Alice
heal if it's needed.

Like the last few battles, it'll probably take long enough that you'll
need to replenish your MP and SP as well. Again, have whoever is doing
the least amount of damage take care of this.

boss.name: Fox Face
boss.strategy:
He won't fuse into the Death Emperor this time, but he'll still use his
!!! attack. When he does, IMMEDIATELY use a Thera Seed, and DON'T even
try to hit the 'Perfect!!' mark; just get Yuri away from 1 HP, and you'll
be fine.

Fuse into either the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit) and
just start wailing away on him with physical attacks. Just keep trading
blows, using Thera Seeds to heal whenever your HP starts to get low, and
ESPECIALLY after the !!! attack.

boss.name: Olga
boss.strategy:
Olga will use normal attacks, Blaze, Rock Storm, Nova, Icy Breath, and
Lightning to do decent damage each round, maybe 50-60 HP of damage every
round. Watch out if she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll
want to recover it immediately if she takes too much.

Cast Blessed Light rounds one and two, then Cure the next if needed.
Blessed Light two rounds, Cure the third. Lather, rinse, repeat. Oh, and
don't forget to recover your SP if needed. Not much else you can do since
it's just Alice.

boss.name: Olga
boss.strategy:
Olga's Black Fog attack will do MAJOR damage to your party, as well as
Poison each one of them, so it's a good idea to come in with Shell or
Cosmic Bracelets equipped. Her Nova attack will do decent damage to a
single ally, her Icy Breath attack will hit your whole party for decent
damage, and her physical attack just does pathetic damage to a single
ally. Watch out if she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll want
to recover it immediately if she takes too much.

Yuri and Alice are obvious choices for this battle, and you could pretty
much pick whomever your favorite is, as they'll all do roughly the same
amount of damage. I recommend Margarete just because I had her at a
higher level than Keith and Zhuzhen, therefore having more STR and HP.
That, and I find Margarete's Ring easier to hit than Keith's. Zhuzhen
just sucks up a lot of MP and takes extra turns to replenish it. Okay,
okay, I really like her too, if that matters any.

Fuse Yuri into Baldo (if you didn't get his level 2 Light Fusion, then
fuse into the Heaven's Fiend, as you'll need the healing) and start
physically attacking; with the Mind's Eye equipped, he'll be doing major
damage. If you didn't put the Mind's Eye on him, then go with the Nova
spell instead.

Have Alice cast Holy Edge on Yuri her first round so he can keep piling
the damage up, then have her cast it on Margarete her second turn so she
can start adding in to the damage. Margarete should also be attacking
normally. If for some reason Alice doesn't need to heal, have her cast
Blessed Light on Olga.

If a single ally just needs healed, have Alice do it. If two people need
it, have Alice and Margarete do it. If all three need it, then have Yuri
do it, as Olga doesn't mess around, and can easily kill your entire party
in three turns. I hate taking turns away from Yuri because he just does
so much damage, but when everyone needs healed, he's the only one that
can do anything about it efficiently.

boss.name: Night Stalker
boss.strategy:
There's not much to worry about with this guy; other than boosting
himself up, his physical attacks do a decent amount of damage, but that's
it. Have Alice whoever is attacked.

Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit, using Ignition to boost his attack power, then
start wailing on the Night Stalker with physical attacks. Have Halley
constantly use his Strong Earth attack, which should do pretty decent
damage to the wind-based enemy. Have Alice keep everyone healed, using
Blessed Light when she's not healing.

boss.name: Jack
boss.strategy:
Jack will mainly just use his Paralysis attack against you, though you
should be guarded by a Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix. He will also use
pretty strong physical attacks, and his Slash attack, which will do MAJOR
damage to one party member, so make sure to stay healed. He will use
Thera Seeds when his HP starts to drop.

When fighting, keep in mind that you have a harder boss battle right
after this, with no chance to heal.

Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then
have him attack as normal. Have Halley cast Strong Earth continuously
(not Aqua Blade, since Jack is water based) for the whole battle, unless
he's learned Air Shot by now, then by all means, use that. Alice should
be healing as needed, using Blessed Light when no healing is needed.

If you're comfortable at the end, take a turn or two to make sure
everyone is healed to the max and ready for the next battle.

boss.name: Mammon
boss.strategy:
Mammon's normal attacks will hit for pretty decent damage, but its
biggest threat is its Petrification attack, which hopefully you've
prevented with either a Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix, though it'll still
do a decent amount of damage, even if you did. It will also use a
Shockwave spell, doing quite a bit a damage to your entire party, as well
as Needlerain, a strong attack to just one party member.

Its Howling skill will replenish its HP by 500+ once it's near dying, but
lucky for you, Yuri's a powerhouse and will take that away and then some
in one round.

As usual, have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his
attack, then have him attack as normal. Have Halley use his Air Edge on
Yuri to increase Yuri's damage output, then have him cast Aqua Blade for
the remainder of the battle, unless he's learned Air Shot by now, then by
all means, use that. Alice should be healing as needed, using Blessed
Light when no healing is needed.

boss.name: Rausan
boss.strategy:
Rausan will usually start out the battle with Elder Sign, causing your
special attacks to be weakened quite a bit. This should only really
affect Halley, but not enough to keep him from using his skills. He'll
attempt to Silence you as well, but as long as you have Cosmic Bracelets,
it'll just inflict a lot of damage. He'll also use Blaze, which will do
a decent amount of damage to your whole party.

As usual, have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his
attack, then have him attack as normal. Have Halley use Aqua Blade every
round (since Rausan is Fire-based), stopping only to help Alice heal.
Alice should be healing as needed, using Blessed Light when no healing is
needed.

boss.name: Olga
boss.strategy:
As before, Olga's Black Fog attack will do MAJOR damage to your party, as
well as Poison each one of them, so it's a good idea to come in with
Cosmic Bracelets equipped. Her normal attacks don't do too much damage,
but her Icy Breath, Rock Storm and Lightning attacks will also both do
quite a bit of damage to your entire party, so be careful. Watch out if
she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll want to recover it
immediately if she takes too much.

Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then
have him attack as normal. With his attacked laced with Alice's Holy
Edge, he'll be doing MAJOR damage. Of course, have Alice use Holy Edge to
start with on Yuri, then have her on healing duty. Have Halley use Air
Shot every round, helping Alice heal as needed.

If you have it, have Alice take advantage of her Arc spell and just heal
every round, it makes this battle MUCH easier.

If you're unable to keep up with healing while trying to dish out the
damage, AND if Alice doesn't have Arc, then have Yuri fuse into Baldo
instead of Ifrit, using his healing spell to take care of the party while
Alice and Halley use Blessed Light and Air Shot to make up the
difference.

boss.name: Albert, Amon
boss.strategy:
Albert's Holy Chest attack will do some decent damage, but even worse,
it'll reduce the amount of SP your entire party has by half, so making
sure that you had those Will Power Accessories equipped will help MAJORLY
in keeping the SP damage from happening. Other than that, he has a
physical attack that will do a decent amount of damage, and his
Revelation attack will also do a decent amount of damage, but to your
entire party with a chance of Instant Death. He rarely uses Revelation,
but if you have problems with the Instant Death it causes, equip some
Leonardo's Bears and try again.

Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit (or Forron if he has it) and cast Ignition (or
Battle Cry) to boost his attack (as well as Margarete's, if you're using
Ifrit and have the time), then have him attack normally every round.
Alice should cast Holy Edge on both Yuri and Margarete to start with,
then have her be devoted each round to casting Arc to keep everyone
healed. Margarete should have the Mind's Eye equipped and attacking
normally while being laced with Holy Edge, just like Yuri.

Any time after dealing over 2000 damage to Albert, he will fuse into
Amon. Continue with the exact same strategy as above, minus the Holy Edge
since Amon is non-class.

Amon's Atomic Dust spell will do pretty good damage to your entire party,
and he'll also hit with his physical attacks, which can cause major
damage to a single ally. You need to watch out for Demon Rays though, as
it'll either kill or nearly kill whomever it hits.

boss.name: Golden Bat
boss.strategy:
He says you have 5 turns to defeat him before he obliterates Keith, but
you technically have 6.

It's not hard to succeed, but if you miss some hits, you could be in
trouble. Keith can only attack normally, so just keep doing that. It
should only take three turns max, unless you didn't equip the Mind's Eye,
then it'll probably take all six.

If you're having a hard time with this battle, then level Keith up to
where he can definitely deal 1500 damage within four or five turns, to be
safe.

NOTE     Even though you already have it equipped for this battle, the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   reward for winning is the DemonSwd-Tyrving......

boss.name: Orb Chaos
boss.strategy:
She has several different spells that will increase her stats by 25-30%,
so once she's done doing that, be very careful, as they went from very
strong to deadly. She WILL almost kill Yuri in one set of attacks once
her attack is boosted, she's THAT strong! Alice won't have time to do
anything except Arc once Orb Chaos starts attacking.

Other than the boosting spells, Orb Chaos attacks normally for major
damage, and uses a spell called Expression that can not only do pretty
good damage, but can also Paralyze your entire party! If you don't have
those Crucifixes equipped, good luck winning, especially when she starts
using Expression each turn, one after another.

Even though he may barely have enough SP to do it, have Yuri fuse into
Amon, then have one of the girls use a Pure Seed/Root on him to give him
some breathing room, then have him attack normally. Alice should be
casting Arc every round, and Margarete should be attacking normally every
round, since both she and Yuri should have Mind's Eyes equipped.

NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Alice's best weapon,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Holy Book-Flesh.

boss.name: Cherubim
boss.strategy:
Ah, Brain Hopper; I miss this music. In any case, Cherubim will usually
start the battle with the !!! attack, reducing a party member's HP to 1,
or Divine Punishment, doing pretty good damage to your entire party, as
well as causing various status effects, so make sure to heal them
straight away. He will continue using them throughout the battle, and his
physical attacks will hit an ally for pretty decent damage as well.

Note that he won't take hardly any damage from your special attacks, so
focus only on physical attacks. Have Yuri fuse into Amon and attack
normally while Alice casts Arc as needed, leaving Margarete to also
attack normally, supporting Alice when needed to replenish Yuri's SP, as
well as Alice's MP.

Cherubim isn't really that complicated, so as long as you have Crucifixes
equipped to everyone and have Alice use Arc every round, then it's just a
matter of taking the time to whittle away his HP. Just make sure not to
let anyone go Berserk.

NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Zhuzhen's best weapon,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Holy Peak Staff.

boss.name: Seraphim
boss.strategy:
Seraphim hits pretty hard, enough to kill right off the bat, so once
again, Alice will be doing nothing but Arc this battle. Other than his
normal attacks, he will use Divine Punishment, doing pretty good damage
to your entire party, as well as causing various status effects, so make
sure to heal them straight away.

Have Yuri fuse into Amon and keep at him with physical attacks, and have
Margarete attack normally as well, taking breaks to help replenish MP and
SP as needed. Since Seraphim has lower HP than Cherubim, you probably
won't have to replenish either MP nor SP.

Like Cherubim, Seraphim isn't really that complicated, so as long as you
have Crucifixes equipped to everyone and have Alice use Arc every round,
then it's just a matter of taking the time to whittle away his HP. It
actually won't take nearly as long, since Seraphim only has 40% the HP
that Cherubim had.

NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Halley's best weapon,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Volt Snipe.

boss.name: Mad Bull, Dragner, Ifrit, Icarus, Baldo, Charon, Lobo, Egil, Forron, Seravi, Sandalphon, Czernobog
boss.strategy:
Rather than list each sub-boss separately, I'm covering them all in this
one section, since each one requires basically the same strategy.

Each of their HP varies depending on Yuri, so if he's weaker, they'll be
weaker as well, and vice versa.

If you want to use the Mind's Eye, just fuse into Amon and wail on them
for a few rounds, making sure to heal if necessary.

If you don't want to use the Mind's Eye, fuse into the highest level
monster that is the opposite class of the one you're fighting. Make sure
to keep yourself healed if you fear that you'll be taken down fairly
easily.

boss.name: Grail Mask, Gold Mask, Staff Mask, Sword Mask, Grail Mask, Gold Mask, Staff Mask, Sword Mask
boss.strategy:
1st Encounter = Stronger form, must be fought in order for easy battles.
2nd Encounter = Weaker form, defeated once and have lost their powers.

1) Grail Mask - He's a joke. Your hit area will be DOUBLED, and he's
easily damaged by physical attacks. He should only take two turns, max.

2) Gold Mask - A little harder than the Grail Mask, but not by much. He
can't be harmed by physical attacks, so you must take him out with
nothing but special attacks. It'll take longer than the Grail Mask, but
he's not a threat at all.

3) Staff Mask - A little easier than the Gold Mask, but not by much. He's
just the opposite of the Gold Mask; he can't be harmed by special
attacks, so you must take him out with nothing but physical attacks, so
it shouldn't be a problem. Again, not very much of a threat at this
point.

4) Sword Mask - The last of the Masks is actually almost as easy as the
first! He doesn't have any strong points like the last two, nor do you
have a wider hit area, but either way, it should only take two,
possibly three rounds to take this one out.

5) Round Two! - Once you have defeated all Four Masks, keep your Malice
in the red and wait for them to come around to fight once more! This
time around, they don't need to be fought in any order, and they only
take one hit to die. Make sure to do this so you get all eight of their
entries for the Monster Library.

boss.name: Atman
boss.strategy:
Atman can still kill Alice in two rounds, so make sure that she stays
healed. As for attacks, this time around, Atman will still use
Eradication, but it won't kill; instead, it'll just do a pretty good
amount of damage, as well as reduce SP. He can also attack normally, as
well as use Dragon Cry and other strong class spells for decent damage.

Have Yuri fuse into Amon and rip into Atman with physical attacks, while
Alice should be using Arc every round to keep their HP maxed. If for some
reason she gets a free turn, have her cast Advent to help Yuri deal some
damage.

boss.name: Ben Hyuga, SeraphicRadiance
boss.strategy:
'———————————————————'   preferably, a Thera Extract.

Fuse into Amon, or if you need some spare SP, then Lobo (since he has the
2nd highest P-Def at this point, as well as the same P-Atk as Amon). All
you'll be doing is physically attacking a round or two, then healing the
next. Yep, that's it... pretty boring actually, but any other route will
likely get you killed. Trust me, it's worth it.

If you find yourself in trouble, try using Third Keys to help dish out
damage when you have an opportunity to. If you're STILL having trouble
with him, then you'll just have to level up and try again.

boss.name: Soul Block
boss.strategy:
Yes, I know, Yuri's level is insanely high, but blame the game for not
letting you be able to take him out of your party so you can level others
up. It shouldn't affect much, as he's just as much of a powerhouse ten
levels earlier.

In any case, the Soul Block CANNOT be harmed physically, so it'll be up
to your special attacks to take him out. He has some really strong
physical attacks, as well as the light spell, Pulse, and the Shockwave
spell, neither of which are quite as strong, but hit everyone.

Fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting For Everyone
to boost your party, then have him continually cast For Tomorrow. (Just
know that For Everyone ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster
ring, so if you can't keep up with it, don't worry about casting it to
begin with.)

Have Alice use Advent and have Margarete use Diving Bomber; whoever is
dealing the least amount of damage (likely Alice), have her replenish
Yuri's MP with Mana Roots every other round. Yuri's For Tomorrow SHOULD
keep your party healed, but in case it falls behind, have Alice ready
with an Arc to bring you back up to snuff.

If you're having trouble with the hit areas of the SeraphicRadiance, then
you may want to start using Bronze Daggers (or Arrowheads for just Yuri)
on your party to widen the hit areas. If you're STILL having trouble,
then you'll probably be better of using Amon and his Demon Rays spell.

boss.name: Hate
boss.strategy:
Hate will use Hate Storm and Black Fog, but luckily we have Crucifixes
now, so as long as they're equipped, we'll just receive minor to decent
damage to the whole party instead of ring anomalies and poison. It'll
also attempt to paralyze you, but will do a decent amount of damage to a
single ally instead.

Fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting For Everyone
to boost your party, then have him continually attack from there on,
using Third Keys if you have spares, with Alice's Holy Edge on him.
(Remember, For Everyone ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster
ring, so if you can't keep up with it, don't worry about casting it to
begin with.)

Have Alice start off by casting Holy Edge on both Yuri and Margarete,
then use Advent when healing isn't needed, and have her use Arc when it
is. Margarete should be attacking physically as well with Third Keys.
This boss is actually a lot easier than the last.

boss.name: Scapegoat
boss.strategy:
The Scapegoat will use Wind Fang that will hit your whole party for a
small amount of damage, and will also attack normally on a single ally
for decent damage. He can also use Deathtouch, which if you remember,
instantly puts an ally into critical HP status, so make sure to heal
straight away when he uses it.

As usual, fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting
For Everyone to boost your party, then have him continually attack from
there on, using Third Keys if you have spares. (Remember, For Everyone
ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster ring, so if you can't keep
up with it, don't worry about casting it to begin with.)

Have Alice use Advent when healing isn't needed, and have her use Arc
when it is. Margarete should be attacking physically as well with Third
Keys. Just make sure to stay healed and you should be fine.

boss.name: Messiah, Meta-God
boss.strategy:
He will start the battle off with Holy Chest, which would normally dampen
your SP, but with the Will Powers equipped, it'll only do a decent amount
of damage. He will also use the !!! attack, so make sure that you heal
IMMEDIATELY after it hits so you don't lose your ally. Other than that,
he just uses Status Abnormality, which won't do hardly any damage, and as
long as you have a Crucifix on, you don't need to worry about the
anomalies.

He can also heal himself with Grace, and even though it only SAYS 999 HP
is healed, trust me, a lot more than that is healed. There is no cap on
the damage or amount healed; just the numbers displayed.

As usual, fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting
For Everyone to boost your party, then have him continually attack from
there on, using Third Keys. There is one more battle after this, so save
your Fifth and Seventh Keys for that. (Remember, For Everyone ALSO boosts
your AGL, and that means a faster ring, so if you can't keep up with it,
don't worry about casting it to begin with.)

Alice will most likely be casting Arc every round, but whenever she
happens to get a free turn, have her cast Advent. Margarete should be
attacking physically as well with Third Keys.
